headline.en: Affinius Capital, Axonic Capital Lend $48M for Suburban Boston Apartments
headline.zh: Affinius Capital与Axonic Capital为波士顿郊区公寓项目提供4800万美元贷款

summary.en: Affinius Capital and Axonic Capital originated $48 million in construction financing for Dinosaur Capital Partners. The loan funds a 130-unit multifamily project at 7 Hartwell Avenue in Lexington, Mass., outside Boston.
summary.zh: Affinius Capital与Axonic Capital为Dinosaur Capital Partners发放了4800万美元建设融资。该贷款用于在马萨诸塞州列克星敦市Hartwell Avenue 7号建设一个拥有130个单元的多户住宅项目，该项目位于波士顿郊区。

source.publisher: Commercial Real Estate Financing | Commercial Observer

headline.en: Apollo, BDT & MSD Partners Provide $197M to Build Naples Luxury Condos
headline.zh: Apollo与BDT & MSD Partners为那不勒斯豪华公寓项目提供1.97亿美元融资

summary.en: Kolter Urban and BH Group secured $197 million in construction financing for Olana Naples Residences, a 12-unit estate-style condominium project in Naples, Fla. Apollo Global Management and BDT & MSD Partners provided the debt. The developers plan to break ground before the end of 2026 and complete construction by 2028.
summary.zh: Kolter Urban和BH Group为佛罗里达州那不勒斯的Olana Naples Residences项目获得1.97亿美元建设融资，该项目将建成12套庄园式公寓。Apollo Global Management与BDT & MSD Partners提供了这笔贷款。开发商计划在2026年底前动工，并于2028年完成建设。

headline.en: Downing expands credit platform with £500m funding line
headline.zh: Downing以5亿英镑融资额度扩展信贷平台

summary.en: Downing has expanded its private credit platform with a new £500m institutional funding line and the appointment of a commercial real estate lending head. The £2.6bn investment firm said the funding line is intended to increase its deployment capacity.
summary.zh: Downing通过新的5亿英镑机构融资额度以及任命一名商业房地产贷款主管，扩展了其私人信贷平台。这家管理规模26亿英镑的投资公司表示，该融资额度旨在提升其部署能力。

headline.en: Pretium adds Cascade Financial Services to residential credit platform
headline.zh: Pretium将Cascade Financial Services纳入住宅信贷平台

summary.en: Pretium, a specialized investment firm managing more than $70 billion in assets, announced that Cascade Financial Services is joining its ecosystem. Cascade is a lender supporting individual borrowers in the purchase of manufactured homes. Pretium said the move expands access to affordable homeownership through manufactured housing lending.
summary.zh: 管理超过700亿美元资产的专业投资公司Pretium宣布，Cascade Financial Services将加入其生态系统。Cascade是一家为个人借款人购买预制房屋提供支持的贷款机构。Pretium表示，此举通过预制房屋贷款扩大获得可负担住房所有权的渠道。
